title: About DealScout
intro: DealScout at Dealscouted.com helps you compare current Amazon discounts by department and budget.

sections.title: What we check
sections.text: Offers pass automated pricing, availability and product-data checks. Public deals require a price check within the past 24 hours. Manual controls let us reject unsuitable listings and correct mistakes.

sections.title: What a discount means
sections.text: Savings compare the checked offer with the reference price supplied by the Amazon listing. That reference is not a historical average or proof of an all-time low. Compare the exact model, size, seller and quantity; confirm final pricing and terms on Amazon.

sections.title: How recommendations work
sections.text: Publication does not imply hands-on testing or a personal recommendation. DealScout Picks carry a separate editorial note when an editor has added one. Department buying notes help you check the details that affect value.

sections.title: How we earn
sections.text: As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases. Affiliate links are marked for search engines. You can read our disclosure or report an incorrect listing through Support.
